review.schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 general marking instruction; 4 listening tariffs (3 mharc × 4 for each Cuid A and B extract, 3 mharc × 2 for each Cuid C piece; the only print of the 0–6 language deduction); 5–8 transcript (never shown to students; Píosa a Dó fills the top of PDF 8); 8–10 listening answers, Fógra a Dó first and then the Fógra a hAon grid (PDF 8), then the paper's order, ending with the mark-total boxes on PDF 10; 11 composition marking (tariffs, the Cumas Gaeilge definition, the bracketed content note, the examiner's Nóta, and a bracketed Nóta defining “Gaeilge Lochtach” for the questions that follow, i.e. Paper 2). The 2014 scheme prints no 40-mark table; 24 modified marking (SMM; text only, no bands). PDF 12–23 are Paper 2; 25–27 are blank and 28 empty.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening answers with alternatives (e.g. Fiche nó 20; Nuacht nó ceol nó spórt nó caint; 18 / ocht lá dhéag) are accepted answers to one task, not routes.

Card unit for listening: six segment cards, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion (20 questions at 3; the four Fógra a hAon grid questions included; 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: closed choose-two of four sections; each printed title is a 50-mark card. Choice is not a route: no two-section combination cards are published; the choose-two instruction is in each title card’s task requirements. Letter/email, dó/di and leis/léi wording stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.

caveats: Paper 1 = 160: listening 60 (Cuid A 24 = Fógra 1 12 + Fógra 2 12; Cuid B 24 = Comhrá 1 12 + Comhrá 2 12; Cuid C 12 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 6) and composition 100 (any two of A–D at 50: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40).
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 6 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 4 in 2014; it is one section-level deduction, and cards state it without applying it.

Fógra a hAon is a printed grid (“Líon isteach an t-eolas atá á lorg sa ghreille anseo.”) of four unnumbered questions; the 2014 key prints them after Fógra a Dó on PDF 8, each as “answer 3 mharc” in the grid's right column, and the fourth prices its parts (“061 (1 mharc) + 92917 (2 mharc)”). Each grid question is its own 3-mark criterion.
Cuid C's answers carry no price of their own (“3 mharc Fiche nó 20”): the question's printed tariff prices them.

The 2014 composition marking prints no headed Tasc, Ábhar and Cumas Gaeilge sections and no 40-mark table: the tariff block (Leathleathanach nó breis: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40) is the Tasc criterion's text; the bracketed note “[Gearrfar pionós ar iarrachtaí ceapadóireachta nach bhfuil ad rem.]” is the content guidance, lifted as the Ábhar criterion's text; the Cumas Gaeilge definition ((i) Stór Gaeilge 40%, (ii) beachtas 50% agus litriú 10%) and the examiner's Nóta are the Gaeilge criterion's text. The last bracketed Nóta defines “Gaeilge Lochtach” for “na ceisteanna ina dhiaidh seo” (Paper 2's deductions) and is not composition guidance.
Modified marking (PDF 24) names the 40-mark Cumas Gaeilge assessment but prints no bands for it.
Paper prints “t-” with ASCII hyphens and “d’iarrthóirí” with U+2019; cards keep the paper's characters.
No 2014 Ordinary card existed before this review; the 15 cards are new.

Treoracha d’iarrthóirí
Ní mór do na hiarrthóirí cúram a dhéanamh de chruinneas na teanga. Caillfear marcanna má bhítear faillitheach ann. Ní mór ceangal cinnte leanúnach a bheith ann idir an teideal a roghnaítear agus an t-ábhar a scríobhtar.

Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo.

A · GIOTA LEANÚNACH / BLAG (50 marc)
Scríobh giota leanúnach nó blag (leathleathanach nó mar sin) ar cheann amháin de na hábhair seo.
(i) An tír is fearr liom.

criteria.label: An Tasc
guidance: Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo. I gcás A, B, C, agus D (Dhá cheann le freagairt) Leathleathanach nó breis: Tasc = 2 mharc Ábhar = 8 marc = 50 marc x 2 Cumas Gaeilge = 40 marc = 100 marc

criteria.label: An tÁbhar
guidance: [Gearrfar pionós ar iarrachtaí ceapadóireachta nach bhfuil ad rem.]

criteria.label: An Cumas Gaeilge
guidance: Cumas Gaeilge = (i) fairsinge agus saibhreas Stór Gaeilge an iarrthóra (= 40%) agus (ii) beachtas maidir le máistreacht cruinnúsáide ar na príomhghnéithe de cheart na Gaeilge (= 50%) agus litriú (= 10%).

Nóta: Caithfidh an Scrúdaitheoir an marc a bhronntar as 2 (Tasc), an marc a bhronntar as 8 (Ábhar) agus an marc a bhronntar as 40 (Gaeilge) a thaispeáint go soiléir ag bun na n-iarrachtaí ceapadóireachta.

cards.markingGuideNote: Whole 50-mark composition: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40. The 2014 scheme prints no 40-mark table: Cumas Gaeilge is judged on its printed aspects, (i) the range and richness of the candidate’s Irish (40%) and (ii) accuracy in the main features of correct Irish (50%) and spelling (10%), so the award can take any value from 0 to 40. Scéim Mharcála Mhodhnaithe (scheme PDF 24): for eligible candidates, spelling and certain grammar features are not penalised in this 40-mark assessment; the scheme prints no bands for it. The letter or email (C) and the dó/di, leis/léi wording are flexible forms inside one response, not separate routes.
